set x to 1
if x = 1 then
	set y to 1
else if x = 2 then
	set y to 2
else
	set y to 3
end if
if x = 1 then
	set y to 4
else
	set y to 5
end if
repeat
	exit repeat
end repeat
repeat 3 times
	set x to x + 1
end repeat
repeat with i from 1 to 10
	set x to x + i
end repeat
repeat with i from 10 to 1 by -1
	set x to x + i
end repeat
repeat with v in {1, 2, 3}
	set x to x + v
end repeat
repeat until x > 100
	set x to x + 1
end repeat
repeat while x < 200
	set x to x + 1
end repeat
